children.description: Child component. Not displayed if **message** prop is passed.

message.description:
Text or rich text content for the body of the modal.
Not displayed if **children** prop is passed.

onCancel.description: Callback for when the cancel button is pressed.

onConfirm.description: Callback for when the confirm button is pressed.

onRequestClose.description: Callback for whenever a user's action should close the modal.

open.description: Controls if the modal is open or not.

variation.description: Type (Work or destructive) for confirm button.
